repeat_acquisition.interpretation: Failure is in provider extraction before audio/decode/ASR. The same URL was accessible earlier, and the same extractor error occurred outside batch in earlier runs. No batch-specific fault, HTTP 429/403, rate limit or exact failed extraction phase is established.
repeat_acquisition.mixed_harness_expectation: Harness chose the previously successful Dailymotion and a failed YouTube fixture, then required one success and one failure. Both new acquisition attempts failed; original overall/mixed failures remain unchanged.

possible_generic_acquisition_improvement.observed_code: _download_source_audio calls ydl.extract_info(url, download=False), validates the returned metadata, then ydl.download([url]); installed yt-dlp download() calls extract_info again.
possible_generic_acquisition_improvement.proposal: If separately implemented and reviewed, download the already validated extracted video result through the supported process_ie_result(info, download=True) path while preserving playlist/duration/size checks and no implicit retries or credential changes.
possible_generic_acquisition_improvement.evidence_support: Avoids one redundant extraction/provider round-trip per successful acquisition and its additional failure opportunity.
possible_generic_acquisition_improvement.not_established: This artifact does not identify whether the first metadata extraction or second extraction failed, so reuse is not proven to fix this batch failure. No provider request or prototype execution was performed.
possible_generic_acquisition_improvement.more_direct_diagnostic_gap: Phase-tagged metadata-extraction versus transfer errors would distinguish those two existing calls without rerunning a provider.
